# WoW AndroWhere 0.9.2

- **Your own server: account creation works.** Setup in 0.9.1 stopped at "Creating your account" with a database error (No database selected). Press Continue setup after updating and it picks up from there.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.9.1 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
